nodes.name: 何叔衡

nodes.name: 东方红校区
nodes.desc: 学校主校区之一，位于长沙市岳麓区枫林三路，田汉剧场、美术馆、图书馆、润之广场与名人墙都在这里。
nodes.desc_en: One of the university's main campuses on Fenglin Road, Yuelu District, home to the Tian Han Theatre, Art Museum, Library, Runzhi Square and Celebrity Wall.
nodes.image_credit: 图片：东方红校区手绘地图（学校提供）
nodes.image_credit_en: Image: official illustrated map of the Dongfanghong campus

nodes.name: 田汉剧场
nodes.desc: 以校友田汉命名的剧场，承担校园演出、讲座与文化活动。
nodes.desc_en: A theatre named after alumnus Tian Han, used for performances, lectures and campus cultural events.
nodes.image_credit: 图片：东方红校区手绘地图（局部）
nodes.image_credit_en: Image: detail of the official campus map

nodes.name: 美术馆
nodes.desc: 东方红校区美术馆，展示师生美术作品与校史主题创作。
nodes.desc_en: The campus art museum, showing works by staff and students and school-history-themed creations.
nodes.image_credit: 图片：东方红校区手绘地图（局部）
nodes.image_credit_en: Image: detail of the official campus map

nodes.name: 图书馆
nodes.desc: 东方红校区图书馆，服务教学科研，藏有师范教育、湖湘文化与红色文献。
nodes.desc_en: The campus library, supporting teaching and research with collections on teacher education, Huxiang culture and red documents.
nodes.image_credit: 图片：东方红校区手绘地图（局部）
nodes.image_credit_en: Image: detail of the official campus map

nodes.name: 润之广场
nodes.desc: 以毛泽东字「润之」命名的广场，位于图书馆与纳湖之间，是校园核心景观与集会空间。
nodes.desc_en: A square named after Mao's courtesy name Runzhi, between the library and Na Lake — a core campus landscape and gathering space.
nodes.image_credit: 图片：东方红校区手绘地图（局部）
nodes.image_credit_en: Image: detail of the official campus map

nodes.name: 名人墙
nodes.desc: 东方红校区名人墙，展示一师历史名师与杰出校友，串联校史人物。
nodes.desc_en: The campus Celebrity Wall, introducing the school's historic teachers and distinguished alumni.
